fixes.defect_1_global_control_contract: Dashboard actions stop_all, resume_ready_platforms, and emergency_stop cross the real HTTP handler into one explicit canonical boundary, durable control_requests rows, RPC consume/ack, and worker behavior. Graceful stop-after-current remains distinct from emergency stop; resume-ready does not clear challenge truth or completed work.
fixes.defect_2_challenged_supervisor: A challenged platform becomes a low-activity commandable supervisor. It preserves its owned target, consumes bounded durable controls, supports focus/recheck/resume/stop, and performs no repeated readiness probes, reloads, navigation, or source-site polling while challenged.
fixes.service_worker_reattachment: On MV3/service-worker restart, recorded IDs are validated through current chrome.windows/chrome.tabs state and expected-platform URL checks before reuse. Stale IDs are diagnostics only; explicit recovery creates at most one replacement target and normal resume never duplicates windows/tabs.
fixes.defect_3_control_instance_identity: Each dashboard activation gets one UUID request instance held across HTTP retries. Exact duplicate delivery deduplicates one effect; tuple conflicts are rejected; later same-action activations get independent durable rows and acknowledgements, with stale-ack protection retained.
fixes.run_finalization: Paused/challenged worker state is visible and partial/incomplete rather than falsely completed or indefinitely healthy-running; healthy terminal workers remain distinguishable from externally blocked work.
